if cell.get('grader_kind') == 'flink_isolated_native':

            from transfer_flink_grade import run_flink_grade

                                   out / 'runtime-snapshot/receipt.json', out / 'flink-native-grade', shared_verifier_deadline)
            verify_tree(locked, files)
            record(status='valid', reward=value['reward'], grader_finished_at=time.time(),
                   private_grader_executes_candidate=False, installed_runtime_preserved=True)
            return result
